Class BankPaymentFlowControllerTest

@IsTest()
private class BankPaymentFlowControllerTest

Tests for BankPaymentFlowController.send(). Exercises the three payment classes (billPayment, commissionPayment, manual) end-to-end with mocked MercuryService responses, plus the three error paths (recipient bank not found, source bank not found, service returns error).

Group:
    Test Classes

Since:
    08/24/2021

Version:
    1.3


Change Log

  • 08/24/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 09/11/2021 - v1.1 - TestData.setSettingsForRequests() not used anymore.
  • 10/25/2023 - v1.2 - New method commissionPaymentTest() to test paying bill commissions.
  • 05/10/2026 - v1.3 - Replace ExternalId__c with Id in toBankAccountId for consistency. Apply test conventions (TestFor, Assert.* migration); modernize ApexDoc; bump API to 66.0. Rename testData() -> setup(), descriptive test-method names, and snake_case locals to camelCase.

Members

  Modifiers and Type Name Description
private static void
billPaymentTest()
Verifies the bill-payment happy path: builds a customer ACH and an own Mercury bank account, mocks MercuryService with a successful response, calls send() with a billId, and asserts the returned message matches SP_BillPaymentSuccessfullySent and the bill's status flips to BILL_STATUS_TRANSFERRED.
private static void
commissionPaymentTest()
Verifies the commission-payment happy path: creates a CommissionPayment__c with two related bills, an agent ACH bank on a BlazeBite parent account and an own Mercury bank account, mocks MercuryService, calls send() with a commissionPaymentId, and asserts the returned message matches SP_CommissionPaymentSuccessfullySent and the commission's status flips to COMMISSIONPAYMENT_STATUS_PAID.
private static void
manualPaymentTest()
Verifies the manual-payment happy path (no billId/commissionPaymentId): mocks MercuryService, calls send(), and asserts the returned message matches SP_PaymentSuccessfullySent.
private static void
mercuryServiceErrorIsSurfacedTest()
Verifies that when MercuryService returns a non-success response (HTTP 401 with an error body), send() surfaces the formatted error message back to the caller.
private static void
ownBankAccountNotFoundErrorTest()
Verifies that when the source bank account cannot be resolved (random fromBankAccountId), send() returns SP_OwnBankAccountNotFound and never calls MercuryService.
private static void
recipientBankAccountNotFoundErrorTest()
Verifies that when the recipient bank account cannot be resolved (random toBankAccountId), send() returns SP_CustomerBankAccountNotFound and never calls MercuryService.
private static void
setup()
Provisions the org-level settings the controller depends on by calling TestDataFactory.createBlazeBiteSettings() so each test starts with the integration constants in place.
